## Current production authority, September 30

Follow the current six-stage asynchronous workflow in #21. Pending specific approvals and final acceptance use the existing Telegram review queue, mirrored in #72. Continue independent production while answers are pending. The preceding room need not be human-accepted or deployed before starting this room. Declare and respect actual code/asset/story dependencies; do not treat unaccepted work as approved.

Preserve per-room budgets and evidence, one runtime writer/GPU job, and the room's canonical story/objective. A final machine pass queues human room acceptance. No merge or deployment. Older release criteria below remain separate release obligations, not authority for this art worker or a gate on unrelated next-room work.

## Room brief and retained criteria

Part of #21. Production order 16; campaign room 16.

Stable template ID: `swarm-junction`. This is a new environment art pass, not a new campaign room. Previous topology work is retained and does not complete this issue.

Depends on the passenger-vault benchmark and the preceding queue room being complete. Reuse their verified kit where appropriate.

## Landmark and composition

Swarm convergence. Three routes meet around an alien routing organ built into a severed ship distribution hub.

## Models and construction

- Sculpt a low three-root carapace manifold with layered plates, tendon anchor sockets and a recessed central sensory cavity. Give each root a distinct cut end tied to a corridor direction.
- Build torn cable saddles and peeled bulkhead ribs pulled into the organ, plus a damaged human directional gantry kept on the far wall. Growth uses long directional forms rather than scattered nodules.

## Materials and lighting

Charcoal chitin, bone-grey exposed ribs and quiet dark metal lanes. A restrained internal pulse may add atmosphere but must not resemble an attack windup or introduce flashing hazard cues.

## Environmental story

Three invasion paths converge on reactor access, suggesting coordinated intent. No claim of hive explanation or new synchronized enemy AI.

## Combat and circulation

Canonical room 16: Swarm junction. Existing objective: Break the concentrated swarm guarding reactor access. Keep concentrated swarm combat and the three-way convergence plan. Maintain escape turns between all routes and readable incoming threats; central growth must not become an unapproved boss or spawn emitter.

## Room-specific acceptance

- All three root directions read in overview and native gameplay; the room differs from the workshop by radial organization and one routing organ.
- Stress a legal encounter with enemies approaching each arm. No carapace lobe hides spawn emergence, and telegraphs remain distinct from any decorative pulse.

## Delivery checklist

The full production and acceptance contract in #21 applies to this room.

- [ ] Current-main in-game baseline and room-specific implementation checklist.
- [ ] Landmark, supporting architecture and coherent authored assets integrated.
- [ ] Room-specific acceptance inspected during real gameplay.
- [ ] Behavioral tests, required verifier and desktop/phone-class room smoke pass.
- [ ] Same-camera before/after and verified actual combat MP4 with provenance.
- [ ] Independent code and visual review resolved on the final base.
- [ ] Green merged PR, deployed readback and Telegram demo delivery.

Do not close for an intermediate model, topology-only PR or missing demo. Use Refs for partial PRs. No global scene-lighting merge without Viktor's separate visual approval.
